name: Contrast Balance Topography
description: A brutal 'light scaling' inspection. Evaluates the consistency of dynamic range and local contrast across the entire image. Real optical photographs naturally exhibit logical contrast degradation over spatial depth (due to atmospheric haze). Conversely, forged or AI-generated composites shatter this physics law by forcefully dumping extremely high-contrast objects into low-contrast, hazy backgrounds, triggering severe non-physical visual disconnects.
algorithm: Local Contrast Variation & Histogram Grid Mapping
mechanism: The algorithm ruthlessly chops the image into thousands of grid matrices to perform isolated histogram analysis. It hunts for adjacent border regions that exhibit hyper-anomalous contrast jumping. If a hypersharp, hard-shadowed face stands amidst a low-contrast, foggy, underexposed environment, the computational alarms will immediately detonate due to blazing 'out-of-phase' contrast imbalance.
parameters: Estimation Model: Local Contrast Variation, Analysis: Grid Histogram Impulses, Color Space Tracker: Luma (YCbCr)
accuracy: Moderate (65-75%) - A perfect forensic mine-detector aimed directly at sloppy Photoshop compositors who fail to synchronize luminosity and tonal layers.
source: Stamm & Liu (2008) - Blind Forensics of Contrast Enhancement
useCase: Acts as a relentless inquisitor scrutinizing illumination discontinuities, stripping the camouflage off spliced components when they appear aggressively over-contrasted or unnaturally flat compared to their immediate surroundings.

references.title: Stamm, M.C. & Liu, K.R. (2008). Blind forensics of contrast enhancement in digital images. IEEE ICIP.

strengths:
• Exceptionally lethal against 'rushed drag-and-drop composites': Pasting a brightly noon-lit car into a twilight horizon will be unmasked mercilessly.
• Computationally blistering fast and incredibly hard to bypass unless the manipulator possesses a deep understanding of optical dynamic range synchronization.
limitations:
• Will completely lose its mind and trigger massive False Positives if the authentic photo contains intense, isolated localized light sources (like a direct camera flash, neon signs, or harsh street lamps).
• Vulnerable to being blinded if an elite retoucher surgically utilizes Match Color/Tone Curve mapping to artificially fuse the spliced object's contrast histogram flawlessly into the environment.
